label: TP-Link EAP610-Outdoor
description: AX1800 outdoor Wi-Fi 6 access point: one gigabit port with 802.3at or passive PoE, dual-band 802.11ax.
notes: Vendor figures from the TP-Link datasheet: 1x gigabit Ethernet RJ-45 port supporting 802.3at PoE and passive PoE; IEEE 802.11ax/ac/n/g/b/a with 802.11ax rates from 8 Mbps to 1201 Mbps (MCS0-MCS11, NSS 1-2, HE20/40/80) on 5 GHz and 802.11ac up to 867 Mbps. Modelled as AX1800: 574M on 2.4 GHz and 1.2G on 5 GHz, the standard 2x2 Wi-Fi 6 split.
